Choosing a camping stove

Three kinds of stove cover most trips, and each trades weight against convenience.

  • Canister stoves screw straight onto a small gas cylinder
  • Liquid fuel stoves burn in the cold and at altitude
  • Wood stoves need no fuel carried at all
TypeWeightBoil timeBest for
Canister85 g3 minWeekend trips
Liquid fuel320 g4 minWinter and expeditions
Wood410 g8 minLong walks in forests

Whichever you choose, test it at home before you leave. A stove that works on the kitchen counter can behave very differently in a crosswind.
